chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Maymun, who said:

Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام arrived performing tamattu' on the night of 'Arafah. He performed tawaf, exited the state of ihram, and went to some of his bondwomen; then he entered into ihram for hajj and departed.

key_terms.أَحَلَّ: he exited ihram and became lawful
key_terms.أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ: he entered into the state of ihram for hajj
key_terms.لَيْلَةَ عَرَفَةَ: the night before the standing at 'Arafah

ai.seo_question: Is intercourse permissible after exiting the ihram of tamattu' before entering ihram for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, after completing the rites that permit release from the ihram of tamattu', became lawful and then approached some of his bondwomen before entering ihram again for hajj. The report is relevant to the fiqh ruling on whether marital relations are permissible after exiting the ihram of 'umrah al-tamattu' and before assuming ihram for hajj.
